news.title: Music producer, DJ killed in robbery. Police release videos of ‘persons of interest’
news.summary: Tarris Caswell, 33, died in the shooting at an apartment complex off McDaniel Street on Aug. 21. Atlanta police need help to identify two persons of interest.

news.title: Family holds hope for Canton mother missing in Tibet after floods
news.summary: A Georgia family refuses to give up hope as rescue crews search for a 60-year-old Canton woman missing after catastrophic flash flooding struck the Nepal-China border.

news.title: Woman dead after shooting at Defoors Ferry Road NW apartment complex
news.summary: Atlanta police are investigating a deadly shooting that left a 22-year-old woman dead early Tuesday morning at an apartment complex in northwest Atlanta.

news.title: 22-year-old woman killed following shooting in northwest Atlanta, police say
news.summary: Police say a woman was shot and killed early Tuesday morning on Defoors Ferry Road NW. No suspect information has been released.

news.title: Cobb County residents grill police over Flock camera privacy concerns
news.summary: Cobb County police hosted a crowded town hall to address residents' growing privacy concerns over Flock surveillance cameras.

news.title: 14-year-old girl lifeflighted after being struck in head with golf club during attack in Newnan: police
news.summary: Newnan Police said that several people have now been arrested in connection to the assault.

news.title: 14-year-old girl hospitalized after golf club assault in Newnan
news.summary: Newnan police arrested several people after a physical altercation on Ball Street left a 14-year-old girl injured Monday evening.

news.title: Nonverbal boy found walking alone, police locate his family
news.summary: DeKalb County police are asking for the public’s help identifying a young boy found Monday afternoon.

news.title: Man walking in northwest Atlanta wounded after hearing sudden gunfire
news.summary: Atlanta police are investigating a shooting near Paines Avenue NW and Donald Lee Hollowell Parkway NW on Monday afternoon.

news.title: 'This is our backyard': Witness recalls ducking for cover during Beltline gunfire
news.summary: Police are investigating a shooting that left several people seeking safety on Atlanta's Beltline Saturday night.

news.title: Repeat break-in suspect caught after disabled car flags police system
news.summary: Atlanta police arrested a 31-year-old man in southeast Atlanta after license plate readers flagged his vehicle.

news.title: Six years in prison for metro Atlanta man in fraud scheme that involved stealing and altering checks, promoting tutorials for check fraud
news.summary: Federal prosecutors announced the prison sentence for 34-year-old Shamarri Brooks on Monday on bank fraud and aggravated identity theft charges.
